description: Implement mx_matches_pattern(mx_hostname: &str, pattern: &str) -> bool per RFC 8461 §4.1 (which references RFC 6125 §6.4 wildcard matching). Rules: exact match (no wildcard) is case-insensitive ASCII hostname comparison. Wildcard pattern '*.example.com' matches 'foo.example.com' but NOT 'foo.bar.example.com' and NOT 'example.com' — wildcard covers exactly one label. No other wildcard forms are valid. The check_mx_against_policy(mx: &str, patterns: &[String]) -> bool function returns true if any pattern matches. Used before TLS connect to verify the MX is in the policy.
title: MTA-STS MX pattern matcher
